papers.title: Nitrogen addition weakens the positive effect of tree diversity on soil microbial biomass
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现导师方向与国家战略；命中“mycorrhizal、biodiversity、restoration、restoration”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract Plant diversity interacts with soil microorganisms to sustain ecosystem functions.
essence.design: This study involved a field experiment in which four levels of tree species richness (1, 4, 8 and 16 species) and N addition were factorially manipulated to assess their effects on total soil microbial biomass, including the biomass of bacteria, fungi and arbuscular mycorrhizal fungi, as well as how N addition modulates these effects.

papers.title: Seasonal decoupling of climate and human activity on litter and dung decomposition across the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现跨学科融合与导师方向；命中“litter decomposition、climate change、management、remote sensing”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract In grassland ecosystems of the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau, litter and dung decomposition are essential for nutrient cycling and productivity.
essence.design: Using remote sensing data, field observations, and machine learning, we examined spatiotemporal patterns of litter decomposition mass (LDM) and dung decomposition mass (DDM) from 2000 to 2020.
essence.innovation: During the NGS, human activity emerged as the near-universal positive driver (> 90% of the area), while the climate weakened substantially, revealing a seasonal decoupling of decomposition controls.
essence.transferableIdeas: 可借鉴其remote sensing、machine learning设计。可参考其气候梯度、极端事件或长期处理设置。可迁移其建模、预测或不确定性分析框架。可借鉴其指标构建与跨尺度验证思路。
essence.limitations: 以上内容基于公开摘要；样本范围、统计细节与因果边界需阅读全文核验。
